2,692 likes, 28 comments - masijeevi on October 20, 2026: "If AI writes the essay, solves the problem, and answers every question, when do children learn to think for themselves?

AI can be a powerful learning tool. But when convenience replaces curiosity and struggle, are we risking the very skills education is supposed to build?

Are we teaching children how to think, or just how to get answers?

#artificialintelligence #education #criticalthinking #parenting #chatgpt".

159K likes, 2,440 comments - masijeevi on October 17, 2026: "Does protesting without proof go against the Constitution? The key distinction is that citizens can demand an investigation and accountability without declaring someone guilty. Protests and court proceedings serve different purposes in a democracy.

Is protest merely a right, or is it also a civic responsibility?

#constitution #democracy #righttoprotest #indianconstitution #civicrights".
